title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, each category becomes a separate column. For example, if you have a column with two categories, 'male' and 'female', how many new columns will you create?

title: Columns in the Design Matrix
text: Consider the columns that will be created from one-hot encoding the 'sex' and $$'embark_{town'}$$ columns. How many columns will each of these variables contribute to the design matrix?

title: Counting One-Hot Encoded Columns
text: How many columns will the 'sex' column contribute after one-hot encoding?

title: Counting One-Hot Encoded Columns for Embark Town
text: How many columns will the $$'embark_{town'}$$ column contribute after one-hot encoding?

title: Total Columns in the Design Matrix
text: Add the number of columns from one-hot encoding 'sex' and $$'embark_{town'}$$ to the original columns. How many columns does this result in?
